description.zh-CN: 让摄像机沿主体轴线同时后退和升高，从近景主体逐步揭示完整载具或大场景。
description.en-US: Fly backward and upward along the subject axis to reveal the full vehicle or environment in one continuous move.

zh-CN.prompt: 摄像机从主体前方[2.5]米、离地[3]米的位置开始，沿主体轴线以一次连续加速的运动向后并向上飞行，在结尾达到约[40]米距离和[25]米高度。主体首先保持在画面中央，随后随着画面缩小，完整的[载具/场景]成为居中对象；地平线在画面中持续稳定上升。不得环绕、变焦或反转运动速度。

en-US.prompt: The camera starts [2.5] meters ahead of the subject at [3] meters altitude and flies backward and upward along the axis in one continuous accelerating move, reaching about [40] meters distance and [25] meters altitude by the end. The subject stays centered, then the whole [craft / scene] centers itself in frame as it shrinks; the horizon line rises steadily through the frame. No orbit, no zoom, no speed reversals.
